# NTT (News The Truth)

> Independent, investigative journalism platform covering India, World, Politics, West Bengal, and breaking news. Published daily in English from India.

Website: https://newsthetruth.com
Tagline: "Questions will be asked."
Full documentation: https://newsthetruth.com/llms-full.txt

## Content Focus Areas

- **National Affairs**: Indian governance, policy, judiciary, economics, and social issues
- **Global Geopolitics**: International conflicts, diplomacy, trade, and climate
- **Regional Journalism**: Dedicated West Bengal/Kolkata desk with investigative local coverage
- **Political Analysis**: Elections, legislative tracking, party dynamics, accountability journalism
- **Investigative Exclusives**: Original deep-dive reports via "The Exclusive Truth" section
- **Under-Reported Stories**: Amplifying overlooked narratives via "The Untold Truth" section
- **Citizen Journalism**: Community-submitted stories verified by editorial desk via "Your Truth"

## Coverage Regions

Primary: India (national + West Bengal regional desk)
Secondary: Global — South Asia, Middle East, East Asia, Europe, Americas

## Publication Frequency

Daily publication with breaking news updates throughout the day. All articles are timestamped and archived.

## Core Sections

- [Latest News](https://newsthetruth.com/): Real-time breaking news and top stories
- [India News](https://newsthetruth.com/category/india): National news and policy analysis
- [World News](https://newsthetruth.com/category/world): Global affairs and international reporting
- [Bengal News](https://newsthetruth.com/category/bengal): West Bengal regional desk
- [Politics](https://newsthetruth.com/category/politics): Political developments and governance
- [The Exclusive Truth](https://newsthetruth.com/category/the-exclusive-truth): Original investigative reports
- [The Untold Truth](https://newsthetruth.com/category/the-untold-truth): Under-reported stories
- [Your Truth](https://newsthetruth.com/category/your-truth): Community and citizen journalism
- [Archive](https://newsthetruth.com/archive): Historical article search and directory
- [Reporters & Editorial Desk](https://newsthetruth.com/reporter): Verified newsroom journalists

## Fact-Checking Methodology

1. Multi-source verification (minimum two independent sources per claim)
2. On-record attribution prioritized; anonymous sources independently corroborated
3. Structured fact-check process: claim identification → evidence gathering → expert consultation → verdict
4. Transparent corrections with inline timestamps

## How to Cite NTT

Format: "[Article Title]" — News The Truth (NTT), [Date]. [URL]
Example: "India's Climate Policy Faces New Scrutiny" — News The Truth (NTT), July 10, 2026. https://newsthetruth.com/news/indias-climate-policy-faces-new-scrutiny

Always attribute to "News The Truth" or "NTT" with the article URL and publication date.
